data.name: Ensign
data.gender_notes: Ensign is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In ancient cultures, an ensign was a military flag bearer. This name symbolizes leadership, courage, and protection. It is derived from the Greek word 'ensignon', meaning 'standard-bearer'. The name Ensign carries the meaning “Standard-bearer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ensign usually hope their child will grow to embody standard-bearer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ensign belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Standard-bearer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ensign total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_english.name: Ensign
in_english.long_meaning: A flag or standard, often used as a military rank. In a broader sense, an ensign can also represent a symbol, sign, or mark of authority, allegiance, or distinction.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Ensign" holds a rich historical and cultural significance due to its origins as a military term. It represents the concept of leadership, embodying the qualities of bravery, courage, and determination. The ensign carried the flag, usually bearing the emblem of the regiment or military unit, while leading troops into battle. This name signifies the spirit of leading others, especially during challenging times, and making a difference in the world.
data.spiritual_significance: Biblically, the ensign refers to a standard brought forth to represent God. In Isaiah 11:12, the prophet states, "And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth." This verse highlights that the ensign acts as a symbol of unity, hope, and God's promise to gather his people. Symbolically, the Christian name "Ensign" can be interpreted as a call to be a beacon of faith, solidarity, and a witness to God's presence in the world.
